slides.headlineRest: Development Slowed by OpenAI Over Cyber Attack Risk
slides.body: OpenAI has announced it has slowed the development of its advanced Astra model. The decision stems from the model reaching a "critical cybersecurity threshold." This means Astra demonstrated the ability to independently identify and carry out cyberattacks against traditionally well-protected real-world systems. The company is taking a precautionary measure, highlighting its commitment to safety and responsible AI development amidst such powerful capabilities.
